name: generative-interaction-kernel
description: Generative Interaction Kernel workspace: GIK wire schemas, conformance fixtures, and the reference implementation.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p kernel/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/durable-runtime/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/evaluators/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p adapters/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/blueprint/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p face/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-lifecycle-exp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/blueprint-agent-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/http-sse/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p transports/mcp-http/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p providers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run conformance && npm run typecheck && npm run test:jsonata && npm run test:vitest
scripts.sync:package-licenses: node scripts/sync-package-license.mjs packages/agent-lifecycle-exp packages/blueprint-agent-host packages/kernel packages/controlface packages/agentface packages/blueprint packages/durable-runtime packages/evaluators packages/react packages/transport-http-sse packages/transport-mcp-http packages/provider-blueprint-authoring packages/provider-step-orchestrator packages/gik
scripts.release:gate: npm run sync:package-licenses && npm run build:public-packages && npm run test
